layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.dims-the-fr.text: Dims the frame and shows how long ago the last good picture arrived.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.leave-empty.text: Leave empty to use the card's device

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.motion-stop.text: Motion stops 2 minutes after the last touch, which saves power on a wall tablet.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.moves-slowl.text: Moves slowly, pauses when the card is off screen and stays still when the device asks for reduced motion.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.pan-and-zoo.text: Pan and zoom work on a still picture from a camera, not on live video.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.pictures-ch.text: Pictures change but text stays. Darken behind text works for all of them. On a wall tablet seen from across the room, use large text.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.remove-stat.note: Button (and accessible name) that removes one state-to-picture row. {state} is a Home Assistant entity state, such as 'on' or 'playing'; do not translate it.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.shows-the-f.text: Shows the framing in the preview. It plays even if the device asks for reduced motion, because you asked for it.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.still-pictu.text: Still picture, refreshed every {n} s: the light choice for a quiet backdrop. Use a live camera behind other modules only when live video is really needed.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.strong-blur.text: Strong blur can make older tablets slow.

layer-editor.bg-layer-editor.this-gradie.text: This gradient cannot be shown. Use linear-gradient(180deg, red, blue) or radial-gradient(circle, red, blue).

vars.state: The value that replaces state in the text.

layer-editor.bg-layers-ops.snapshot-fail.text: Snapshot failed. The last good frame stays visible.
